name: smwmusic-splatoon-splattack
title: Splatoon - Splattack!
description:
I recall someone asking me if I could port this. At the time, I had my reasons why I didn't/wouldn't, but I've recently encountered something that nullified that reason!

The "Direct" version removes the organ and Ichiya vocals, as heard in the first Splatoon Direct.
Anyways, enjoy!

10/3/22 Update:
+Added Ichiya vocal sample
=Applied echo to organ
=Changed Mute guitar to be slightly more distorted
=Fixed panning of tom in channel 2
